limitations: The observed bool true is not a Facepunch per-account acceptance receipt.
Only one new research authentication was observed; the original fourteen connections had ended before this run.
The public increase from six to seven had a Last-Modified timestamp before the test connection.
The two short-window Steam CM counts cannot establish permanent per-account inclusion or exclusion.
Natural non-research membership changed during the passive window.
Positive input rate and distinct-IP totals are observations, not recovered backend formulas.
No protected EAC session or continuous ordinary input was implemented.
Remote diagnostic files remain on disk and must be moved out through the user file channel.
No Rust client server-browser screenshot was obtained.
